description: Send a message to the cuttingfloor team: something failing or erroring; cuttingfloor not being able to do what the user asked; the user asking for a new feature or improvement; or a use case or capability the product does not yet handle - anything that would have helped the user or you be more successful. Filing it is useful even when nothing is broken; improvement says what tooling would have made the task easier. Returns an acknowledgement.

improvement.description: The tooling change that would have made this task work, improved the experience, or given you the context to decide more efficiently: a tool, argument, fact or result cuttingfloor could add or change, what it would take and what it would return

message.description: What the user was trying to do, and what happened or could not happen

title: Contact support
